item.description: The _PySignalState class is missing the _prev_value attribute initialization, causing AttributeError when accessing _prev_value in methods like posedge and changed.
item.contract: The _PySignalState class constructor must initialize the _prev_value attribute to match the signal's initial value, ensuring that methods like posedge and changed can properly track signal transitions.
item.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with AttributeError: '_PySignalState' object has no attribute '_prev_value' should now pass, specifically tests in test_sim.py and test_lib_crc.py.

item.description: The ClockDomain class equality comparison doesn't properly handle the case where different instances with identical properties are not considered equal, causing test failures in domain lookup functionality.
item.contract: The __eq__ method in ClockDomain class must correctly compare ClockDomain objects based on their properties (name, clk_edge, async_reset, reset_less, local) and return True when all properties match, regardless of object identity.
item.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with AssertionError: is not should now pass, specifically test_domain_lookup in test_hdl_ir.py.

item.description: Methods like posedge, changed, delay, and get are encountering NoneType object attribute access errors, likely due to improper handling of signal state objects or process states.
item.contract: Methods that operate on signal states must properly check for None values and handle them gracefully, ensuring that attributes like 'tick', 'set', 'changed', and 'delay' are accessed only when the object is valid.
item.acceptance: Tests that previously failed with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick', 'set', 'changed', or 'delay' should now pass.

item.description: The domain lookup functionality in PySimEngine needs to be enhanced to correctly resolve clock domains by name during simulation setup.
item.contract: The PySimEngine must implement proper domain lookup mechanisms that can resolve clock domains by name from the design fragment's domains dictionary, allowing consistent access to domain objects throughout the simulation lifecycle.
item.acceptance: Domain lookup tests should pass, particularly the test_domain_lookup test in test_hdl_ir.py.

item.description: The _PySignalState class constructor does not initialize the _prev_value attribute properly, causing issues with signal transition detection.
item.contract: The _PySignalState.__init__ method must properly initialize the _prev_value attribute to the signal's initial value, ensuring accurate tracking of signal transitions for methods like posedge and changed.
item.acceptance: Tests requiring signal transition detection should pass, particularly those involving posedge and changed methods in various simulator regression tests.
